niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, modern, airy interfaces that feel complete and well-structured. They like pages with clear sectioning, strong hierarchy, and enough visible content to feel finished, but without clutter, heavy decoration, or overly dense controls. They also prefer direct, task-focused copy and prominent, easy-to-understand primary actions.

criteria.description: Multiple clearly separated sections with strong headings and organized grouping
More settings, options, and visible content that make the page feel fully populated
Airy composition with enough whitespace to feel open, but not so much empty space that the page feels sparse
A standard, refined settings-page look that feels complete rather than placeholder-like or unfinished
Short, task-focused wording with minimal explanatory clutter
Clear, visually strong primary buttons or actions that are easy to identify immediately
Each row should feel fully populated and purposeful, with visible labels, icons, and controls rather than blank or incomplete-looking rows
